name: Stripe Revenue Report
author: hearth-team
description: Read-only money-in reporting from YOUR OWN Stripe account. This skill only READS — it never creates charges, refunds, or any write. Args: report (one of 'summary' (default), 'recent_charges', 'failed_payments', 'subscriptions') and limit (optional, for recent_charges; default 10, max 100). 'summary' returns available balance, last-30-day gross volume + successful charge count, active subscription count, and failed payments in the last 7 days. Bring your own STRIPE_RESTRICTED_KEY — a RESTRICTED key with read-only access, never your full secret key.

vault_inputs.label: Stripe restricted key
vault_inputs.help: Create a RESTRICTED key (NOT your secret key) at https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys → Create restricted key. Grant READ (never write) on: Charges, Subscriptions, Invoices, Balance. Starts with rk_live_ or rk_test_. Stored encrypted in your vault.
